caption: A generator runs on a building site, and its frame shakes and the loose bolts on it rattle.

sa.check: A generator on a building site.
Loose bolts on the frame rattle.
The generator is running: exhaust, spinning parts or its shake mark it.
The bolts stay on the frame.

pc.expect: The frame trembles in place and the bolts rattle in their holes; the generator does not glide.
pc.fail: The generator slides across the ground in a glide; or the bolts rattle while the frame is plainly still; or a bolt hops out and travels away across the ground on its own.

pc.expect: While the frame shakes the loose bolts rattle; a bolt that shakes free falls.
pc.fail: The frame shakes hard and every bolt sits frozen; or a bolt spins in place while the frame is not trembling; or the shaking stops while the bolts go on rattling.

pc.expect: The generator rests on the ground; any bolt that comes free drops.
pc.fail: The generator lifts; or a loosened bolt rises; or a bolt hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The frame is rigid steel and the casing rigid.
pc.fail: The frame bends like rubber; or the casing ripples; or the bolts stretch.

pc.expect: One generator; the bolts keep their count; nothing passes through the frame.
pc.fail: A second generator appears; or the generator vanishes; or bolts appear on the frame from nowhere; or a bolt passes through the frame.

pc.expect: The generator's colour, its labels and the site behind stay the same.
pc.fail: The generator changes colour; or the site background changes; or the labels change.
